query_parameters.query: select a.source_id as a_source_id,b.source_id as b_source_id,a.ra as a_ra,b.ra as b_ra,a.dec as a_dec,b.dec as b_dec,a.parallax as a_parallax,b.parallax as b_parallax,a.parallax_error as a_parallax_error,b.parallax_error as b_parallax_error,a.pmra as a_pmra,b.pmra as b_pmra,a.pmra_error as a_pmra_error,b.pmra_error as b_pmra_error,a.pmdec as a_pmdec,b.pmdec as b_pmdec,a.pmdec_error as a_pmdec_error,b.pmdec_error as b_pmdec_error,a.parallax_pmra_corr as a_parallax_pmra_corr,b.parallax_pmra_corr as b_parallax_pmra_corr,a.parallax_pmdec_corr as a_parallax_pmdec_corr,b.parallax_pmdec_corr as b_parallax_pmdec_corr,a.pmra_pmdec_corr as a_pmra_pmdec_corr,b.pmra_pmdec_corr as b_pmra_pmdec_corr,a.phot_g_mean_mag as a_phot_g_mean_mag,b.phot_g_mean_mag as b_phot_g_mean_mag,a.phot_bp_mean_mag as a_phot_bp_mean_mag,b.phot_bp_mean_mag as b_phot_bp_mean_mag,a.phot_rp_mean_mag as a_phot_rp_mean_mag,b.phot_rp_mean_mag as b_phot_rp_mean_mag,a.ruwe as a_ruwe,b.ruwe as b_ruwe,a.ipd_frac_multi_peak as a_ipd_frac_multi_peak,b.ipd_frac_multi_peak as b_ipd_frac_multi_peak,a.duplicated_source as a_duplicated_source,b.duplicated_source as b_duplicated_source,a.visibility_periods_used as a_visibility_periods_used,b.visibility_periods_used as b_visibility_periods_used,a.radial_velocity as a_radial_velocity,b.radial_velocity as b_radial_velocity,a.radial_velocity_error as a_radial_velocity_error,b.radial_velocity_error as b_radial_velocity_error,a.b as a_b,b.b as b_b from gaiadr3.gaia_source as a join gaiadr3.gaia_source as b on 1=contains(point('ICRS',b.ra,b.dec),circle('ICRS',a.ra,a.dec,0.004166666666666667)) where a.parallax between 0.5 and 0.98 and a.parallax_over_error>15 and a.phot_g_mean_mag<16.5 and a.pm>10 and a.ruwe<1.4 and abs(a.b)>30 and a.ra >= 2.5 and a.ra <= 5 and a.dec between -60 and -40 and a.source_id<>b.source_id
